title: The 5 Shortest Days in the Solar System, Ranked (#1 Is a Giant)

scenes.text: The five planets with the shortest days, ranked. The biggest planet of all spins fastest.
Number five: Earth. About twenty-four hours, the slowest spinner on this list.
scenes.label: Earth · 24 hours

scenes.text: Number four: Uranus. About seventeen hours, and it spins tipped on its side.
scenes.label: Uranus · 17 hours

scenes.text: Number three: Neptune. About sixteen hours, at the far edge of the solar system.
scenes.label: Neptune · 16 hours

scenes.text: Number two: Saturn. About ten hours and forty minutes, fast enough to bulge at its equator.
scenes.label: Saturn · 10.7 hours

scenes.text: Number one: Jupiter. A day lasts under ten hours, on a planet that could hold over a thousand Earths.
scenes.label: Jupiter · 9.9 hours

description:
The five planets with the shortest days, ranked by how long one spin takes.
From Earth's twenty-four hours to Jupiter, the giant that spins in under ten.
Which planet would you want the shortest day on?
first_comment: Would you want a ten-hour day? And what should we rank next?
